signature.badge.held.tip: Signed with an {format} key. Not checked: checking it would run the signing program this repository's settings name, and you haven't trusted this repository.
signature.reason.bad: The signature doesn't match this commit: the commit changed after it was signed, or the signature is damaged.
signature.reason.expired_key: The key that made the signature has expired.
signature.reason.good: Good signature from a key you trust.
signature.reason.good_ssh: Good signature from a key your allowed signers file lists for this signer.
signature.reason.no_allowed_signers: SSH signatures are checked against an allowed signers file, and none is set (gpg.ssh.allowedSignersFile). Choose one in Preferences > Commit signing.
signature.reason.no_key: The signer's public key isn't in your keyring, so the signature can't be checked.
signature.reason.revoked: The key that made the signature has been revoked.
signature.reason.untrusted: The signature is good, but you haven't marked this key as trusted in GPG, so who made it isn't confirmed.
signature.reason.untrusted_ssh: The signature is good, but your allowed signers file doesn't list this key for this signer, so who made it isn't confirmed.
